Visiting Hanoi from Houston, TX, where I have been on a rampage to try the best pho in town (HTX) since 2013. From Pho Nguyen in Cypress to Pho Dien in Chinatown, we’ve found some good spots. Michelin-Starred Mayhem: A "Half-Baked" Pho Experience in Hanoi
Jun 2025 • Family
Michelin-Starred Mayhem: A "Half-Baked" Pho Experience in Hanoi
I'm utterly pissed off after my recent visit to this "Michelin-star" pho eatery in Hanoi's famous Hoan Kiem area. The food might be renowned, but their abysmal seating policy and shocking customer service left our family of three feeling completely disrespected.

We ordered two bowls of their special beef pho, along with condiments and drinks, expecting a pleasant family meal. Just five minutes in, the lead waitress had the audacity to tell my wife to leave if she wasn't eating and "make way for others." This immediately sparked a heated exchange, with my wife rightly pointing out that enjoying snacks is also part of the meal!

But the absurdity didn't end there. As I waited for my "famous pho" to arrive, another waitress approached, asking me to move in on our four-seater table. I assumed she needed the chair, but to my disbelief, she then ushered a complete stranger—a tourist, no less—to sit right next to me! I was absolutely flabbergasted. Why would a restaurant, especially one with a Michelin star, force a customer to share a table with a total stranger, compromising privacy and hygiene, all while I'm about to begin my meal?

This "unusual restaurant policy" completely ruined our family dining experience. When you're eating out as a family, you expect a basic level of privacy and comfort. For a place with a "Michelin star award," their meal management and customer treatment are a complete joke and fall far short of any acceptable standard. The long queues might suggest popularity, but our experience proves that a Michelin star doesn't guarantee a quality dining experience.
I stood up and told my wife we are leaving and I told the crowd this idiotic sitting policy is unbecoming of a Michelin star restaurant
